notes.title: Exciting Update Incoming: Unleash the "Holdout" Mode and Revamped Training!
notes.notes:
🎮 New Game Mode: Holdout 🕹️
Engage in intense battles in the all-new Holdout mode! Secure and defend a central point, strategically controlling it for a set duration. Team coordination is key - victory awaits those who can withstand the cosmic onslaught!

🔄 Reworked Training Grounds: 🤖
Sharpen your skills in the revamped Training mode. Choose any map from our cosmic arsenal and face off against advanced AI bots. Hone your tactics, perfect your aim, and become a master of the interstellar battlefield.

🌐 How to Experience the Update:
Update your game to access these thrilling additions. Whether you're conquering points in Holdout or refining your strategies in the enhanced Training mode, this update is set to redefine your Helion experience.
